note.fact_box: Scientists at CSIR-CCMB developed ISS1 and ISS2 on October 02, 2026. The study involved analyzing 171 children at Government Medical College and Hospital, Nagpur, achieving an 85% concordance rate.

note.subject: social_justice
note.why_in_news: Tamil Nadu CM launched the ‘Vettri Payanam’ scheme to provide free bus travel for women and transgender persons across seven State Transport Corporations.
note.fact_box: The scheme was launched on October 2, 2026, at Koyambedu bus terminus, Chennai. It covers 12,695 buses and aims to benefit 84.32 lakh women and transgender persons daily. The scheme excludes Chengalpattu and Tiruppur districts.

prelims_pointers.text: Vettri Payanam: Tamil Nadu state government scheme providing free bus travel for women and transgender persons.
The scheme covers 12,695 buses across seven State Transport Corporations in Tamil Nadu.
The scheme targets a daily benefit for 84.32 lakh individuals.

note.subject: history_culture
note.why_in_news: The Madras High Court directed the Tamil Nadu government to submit a status report on removing caste-based names from public roads and streets.
note.fact_box: The order was issued by the First Division Bench of the Madras High Court on October 1, 2026. It references a 1978 Government Order and a Sendhamangalam police FIR regarding the removal of caste appellations from public infrastructure.
